name: LTO Driver's License (Previous Blue Polycarbonate Design)
description: Land Transportation Office (LTO) driver's license previous design (2017–2021 light blue polycarbonate card with 5-year validity).

fields.name: Headings and Republic Header
fields.description: Header with Republic of the Philippines, Department of Transportation, and Land Transportation Office title.

fields.name: Sex
fields.description: Sex / Gender classification (e.g. M/F) left visible per §8.1.

fields.name: Height
fields.description: Cardholder height in meters left visible per §8.1.

fields.name: Weight
fields.description: Cardholder weight in kilograms left visible per §8.1.

fields.name: Driver Face Photo
fields.description: Front-facing digital photograph of the driver on the left side with guilloche background.

fields.name: Cardholder Signature
fields.description: Digital specimen signature of the driver directly beneath the photo.

fields.name: Driver's License Number
fields.description: License number in standard alphanumeric format (e.g., N01-12-345678).

fields.name: Cardholder Name
fields.description: Driver's full name (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name).

fields.name: Residential Address
fields.description: Driver's residential address printed across the bottom section.
